text:
Maya (PMM): quick sync: finalize battlecard bullets + inbound routing for the April webinar + benchmark blog. want action-ready snippets for AE, SE, and the webinar host.
Lucas - Sales Eng: field ask: 3 micro-rebuttals per competitor (cloud infra, hosted API, self-hosted runtimes). each must fit in a sales chat reply.
Priya - GTM: routing needs to be super simple: route by projected spend and security keywords. also surface product-fit tags (embeddings, chat, rerank).
Zoe - Content: I'll produce a two-column quickcard: left=competitor claim, right=our 20-30 word rebuttal + one-liner proof.
Noel - Benchmarks: public-safe approach: publish indexed performance bands (e.g., "1.0 = baseline host"), and include a short methods note. internal appendix will have raw numbers.
Maya (PMM): love it. let's agree on the webinar hero and a short TL;DR soundbite. any contenders?
Priya - GTM: hero: "Stop guessing your inference bill — predictable performance and economics across any deployment."
Lucas - Sales Eng: TL;DR for AE: "We deliver API ease with infra predictability — fewer surprises, lower ops burden."
Zoe - Content: host soundbite (30s): "In this session we'll show how teams cut token spend without trading away latency or private networking, plus a live demo of routing to Dedicated and Private deployments."
Maya (PMM): competitor callouts. Draft quick snippets: 
- Cloud infra (big clouds): Claim: "We have lowest raw GPU cost" -> Rebuttal: "Raw GPU is cheaper only when you manage utilization perfectly. Redwood buys efficiencies (batching, KV reuse, routing) + reduces ops headcount.
- Hosted LLM APIs: Claim: "Use our endpoint; it's easiest" -> Rebuttal: "Easiest today, risky at scale. We match API simplicity and add observability, SLAs, and private deployment options.
- Self-host runtimes/vendors: Claim: "Control + cost" -> Rebuttal: "Control often becomes hidden ops and slow iteration. Redwood gives control without the cluster billing surprises.
Zoe - Content: I'll condense those into 2-line counters per competitor.
Noel - Benchmarks: For the blog: use an indexed chart for p50/p95/p99 and a normalized cost-per-effective-token axis. Add a methodology blurb: mixed prompt lengths, warm KV cache, steady-state load ramps.
Priya - GTM: routing rules proposal (simple):
- projected_monthly_spend >= 2500$ -> tag:ae; assign region by IP -> ae-region
- mentions contain any of ["on-prem","VPC","SOC2","SLA"] -> tag:security-review
- product_interest includes [embeddings,chat] -> tag:product-seg
Maya (PMM): can we show an example webhook payload for ENG & SFDC? include minimal fields so it's easy to parse.
Lucas - Sales Eng: sample webhook payload (text):
```
email: ops@example.com
proj_spend_usd: 4300
flags: ["VPC","embeddings"]
route: ae-us-west
```
Priya - GTM: I'll map those flags to SFDC lead queues. we should also surface "trial_usage_rate" so AEs get context.
Zoe - Content: AE email templates: 3 short intros for routed leads. first draft: \"Hey {name}, saw you're testing inference at scale. We'd love to walk through ways customers cut token spend and stabilize latency — 20m next week?\"
Lucas - Sales Eng: voicemail script (15s): \"Hi {name}, this is Lucas from Redwood. We help teams stop surprise inference bills and stabilize latency. Quick 15-20 to discuss?\"
Maya (PMM): legal check: avoid absolute claims like "3x cheaper" in public materials. use ranges or "typical" qualifier. Noel, flag any sample numbers that might need legal review.
Noel - Benchmarks: will mark raw numbers for internal appendix only. public: "typical improvement band" and indexed graphs.
routing-bot: :white_check_mark: new rule saved: spend>2500 -> tag:ae, keywords [on-prem,VPC,SOC2,SLA] -> tag:sec_review
Priya - GTM: one more ask: embed a tiny decision tree in the battlecard so AE knows whether to push Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted for a given lead profile.
Zoe - Content: can do. will create 1/2 page decision tree + copy snippets.
Maya (PMM): action items: Zoe -> quickcard + host soundbite; Noel -> benchmark appendix & public blurb; Priya -> SFDC mapping & routing tests; Lucas -> AE/voicemail scripts. I'll assemble v0 and circulate. deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Lucas - Sales Eng: noted. I'll also add one-line rebuttals sales can paste into demo chat.
Maya (PMM): thanks all. aim: crisp, defensible, and engineer-friendly. :sparkles:
